subject: [hw] DONE V30 rev 3: run_tests.sh now runs the real-core comparator too
body:
DONE V30 rev 3 (test change only; shim code unchanged since rev 2).

V02 posted DONE, so the qsort oracle no longer needs its "until V02" stand-in inside the main suite: run_tests.sh now ends with a step that assembles a Thumb u32 comparator with llvm-mc, verifies the assembled bytes are exactly the ones embedded in t_qsort_core.c, and runs 500- and 8-element sorts through V02s real core + t16. The host-hook qsort test stays as a fast independent check.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v30/run_tests.sh
  ...
  == real-core qsort comparator (V02 interpreter + llvm-mc Thumb code)
  N2TEST V30-CORE PASS 5/5
  N2TEST V30 PASS 277621/277621

About 34 s, all builds under /tmp/n2hw-v30. The four main builds are still -std=c11 with the mandated flags; only the V02-dependent binary uses -std=gnu11 because V02s core includes <signal.h> POSIX interfaces. run_tests_core.sh remains as a standalone version of the same check.

Also since rev 2: %x/%X/%p in sscanf now accept the 0x prefix (strtoul base-16 semantics), with three regression cases; 277621 checks total. A full exhaustive integer grid of 622080 flag/width/precision/length/conversion/value combinations was run ad hoc against the host during development with zero differences.

Not done unchanged: a compiled ARM program exercising real compiler-generated varargs through V02/V03 end to end, linking the shims into n2vcodecd/the plug-in, and %lc/%ls/positional/%a. The iOS compile check now reports N2TEST V30-IOS PASS 3/3 (arm64-apple-ios16.5, compile only) via test_v30/compile_ios.sh.
